tasks.request: Correct per-call mutation callback handling when an onSuccess or onError handler starts another mutation with different callbacks. The callbacks for the mutation being settled must keep that mutation’s data, variables and context; onSettled must not call the next mutation’s handlers. Preserve subscription, notification, retry and cache behavior. Add a regression in a new test file under packages/query-core/src/__tests__; preserve existing tests.

In query-core QueryClient.isFetching and the React useIsFetching hook, disallow fetchStatus in the public filter argument: these APIs already count fetching queries. Preserve all other filter fields, their generic inference and return types, and leave fetchStatus supported by general query-cache filtering. Keep runtime behavior unchanged. Scope this change to query-core and react-query, preserving the other framework adapters. Add regression coverage in new files under the existing __tests__ directories; preserve supplied tests. Preserve the existing QueryClient.isFetching generic entry point: an explicit compatible QueryFilters type argument must remain accepted, as must typed predicate inference.
